title: Questions about reaching out
intro: A few practical answers for visitors who are deciding whether to send a message.

sections.heading: Do I have to book immediately?
sections.body: No. You can ask a question first.

sections.heading: Can I remain private?
sections.body: Share only what feels comfortable. The form does not ask for unnecessary personal records.

sections.heading: What if I am not sure?
sections.body: Tell us that. Uncertainty is a valid place to begin.
